interpretation.result: Modest scene-dependent certified-search benefit; no reliable additional partial-QR end-to-end gain.
interpretation.baseline: Already accelerated FORM, not original FORM.
interpretation.scope: All 1190 stairs scans; scaled 250-scan stairs prefixes; additional 600-scan scene prefixes.
limitations: Two clean reversed-order repeats except four for quad_hard.
A100 results do not establish performance on other GPUs.
Exactness audits use original GPU matcher on identical input; they execute the oracle even when a query is certified.
Timing tables exclude 20 warmup scans unless labeled all-scans. Workload means include all scans.
Prior art supports only a limited integrated systems contribution, not a new general certificate or QR principle.
